technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 15ml, this KoColor POLISH is expertly formulated with Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Isopropyl Alcohol, Red 7 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Ruby Catalyst color profile (`#9B111E`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
